irregularities: Prompt values 0.4413 and 0.3195 do not match the repo's recorded official top of 0.4544; no receipt for either.
The nine historical scores (0.2449–0.2778) are user-reported only; no organizer receipt exists in the repository.
Data in data/official/ are owner-mirror copies (6GEMSDOE), not organizer downloads; the competition data page redirects to login.
The portal error 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' is unexplained. The new file's in-footprint values are in [0,1]; its out-of-footprint cells are NaN, as the official rule requires.
The E3 holdout score measures a different dot allocation from the emitted file (see holdout).
The uniqueness scan covers only docs/downloads (1,817 of 3,273 GeoTIFF blobs); 24 registry rasters could not be compared (CRS/grid mismatch, NaN inside footprint, or corrupt header).
The 3-px forward overlap rule is directional and was used as written; its measurement against dense surfaces is trivially 100%. The gate was not re-interpreted to pass.
The repository review cites base 351c64c and branch arena/cf36ddec, which do not match this branch (branch base 404231f).
The GitHub Pages URL for this repository was not verified in this session; links are relative.
